_comment: Final retirement disposition for every patch in patches/astro/series, for issue #8.
Companion to patch-retirement.md, which carries the reasoning and the evidence.
Hand-maintained: a retirement decision is a judgement, not a property of a diff.
Derived from COMMITTED state (git archive HEAD patches/astro). Two patch files
carry uncommitted edits (020, 046); the delta is recorded in patch-retirement.md
section 8 and changes no classification here.
A-auto        no Chromium-owned change once //astro exists and is linked
B-hook        behaviour survives behind a named minimal Chromium hook
D-scheme      exists only because astro:// is not a real scheme (#11/#12/#13)
E-policy      inherited or product behaviour needing a decision (#10, #20)
O-obsolete    the surface stops being Astro's product surface; remove
R-remove      must not survive in any form; no successor hook
F-unclassified  stated as unclassified rather than guessed (hunk level only)
A patch carries hunk_classifications when it does more than one thing. A patch
that is mostly branding with one security-relevant hunk is NOT filed as branding

CL-1.name: Build & asset ownership
preconditions: //astro exists as a real GN target with its own BUILD.gn
//astro declares aggregate_vector_icons and owns alia_spark.icon
#16 has chosen OSCrypt sync vs async for the token store

CL-2.name: Preference registration
preconditions: astro::RegisterProfilePrefs and astro::RegisterLocalStatePrefs exist
#20 has ruled on the six inherited deletions carried by 020
#16 has confirmed oxy.access_token / oxy.refresh_token are not carried over
046 retires no earlier than 020

CL-3.name: WebUI config registration
preconditions: //astro's ChromeBrowserMainExtraParts registers its WebUI configs at PostProfileInit or PreBrowserStart
the untracked whole-file copy of chrome/browser/ui/webui/chrome_web_ui_configs.cc is deleted in the same change
055 retires no earlier than 054
CL-3.note: needs no Chromium-owned edit: WebUIConfigMap's Add*WebUIConfig are public and RegisterChromeWebUIConfigs is only one caller

CL-4.name: Adblock browser integration
preconditions: throttle, tab-helper and toolbar hooks exist
the undeclared ToolbarView adblock_button_ member is designed, not inherited

CL-5.name: Alia integration
preconditions: astro::RegisterSidePanelEntries exists
the two X-macro enum entries are accepted as the minimum Chromium delta

CL-6.name: Identity
preconditions: none — this cluster retires by deletion and is a PRECONDITION for linking //astro, not a consequence of it

CL-7.name: Theme
preconditions: astro::AddColorMixers exists
the inactive-tab-foreground change is a stated decision

CL-8.name: Scheme trust core
preconditions: the astro:// trust model is written down: which of standard/secure/CORS-enabled/savable it gets, and what astro-untrusted:// is

CL-9.name: Scheme navigation & origin
preconditions: CL-8 landed
origin / SiteInstance / process-lock assertions pass
036 already removed (it conflicts with 026)

CL-10.name: Scheme display & persistence
preconditions: CL-9 landed
the ungoogled content captured in 023 and 027 is handed to #8's ungoogled curation rather than ported
the legacy-URL migration decision exists for sessions already on disk (042)

CL-11.name: New Tab Page surface
preconditions: astro://newtab is the product NTP
CL-3 landed
the shipped tile list is a stated product decision (#10)

CL-12.name: Branding & product constants
preconditions: one source of truth generates names, identifiers and strings
the privacy-disclosure strings are re-authored rather than substituted
the six deleted help links have a decision
the copyright/attribution replacement in 001 is confirmed acceptable
CL-12.note: order-independent; the epic explicitly parallelises #8 and #9

CL-13.name: Inherited & product policy
preconditions: the feature matrix and network manifest exist (#10)
the security baseline decision exists (#20)
044 retires together with extra/iridium-browser/Remove-EV-certificates.patch

retirement_order.note: order-independent, may run from the start in parallel with #7
HARD GATE. Linking //astro while 011/036/039 are still in the stack switches on a token-in-URL identity flow for the first time. Delete before, or in the same change as, the build hook.

dependencies.detail: 046's hunk context is 020's last added line
same pre-image blob b5c2da1226eae, same insertion point; 036 contains 026 verbatim plus the auth interception
044 exists only to repair that patch's dummy EV root
declared in tools/overlay.allowlist; the copy omits the adblock config
assigns to adblock_button_, which nothing declares

security_review_queue._note: Issue #20 owns these decisions and must not inherit any of them silently. 'inherited' means an ungoogled patch already makes the identical deletion; 'astro-originated' means no ungoogled patch does.

items.detail: access_token and refresh_token arrive in a URL query, are accepted from any navigation to the callback URL with no state/PKCE/origin check, and the JWT payload is base64-decoded without signature verification. Violates the epic's non-negotiable rule. Inert today only because the overlay is not in the build.
oxy.access_token and oxy.refresh_token registered as profile string prefs, i.e. plaintext JSON on disk.
safe_browsing::RegisterLocalStatePrefs, safe_browsing::RegisterProfilePrefs, ntp::SafeBrowsingHandler::RegisterProfilePrefs. Dropping the ungoogled patch does NOT restore these.
SSLErrorHandler::SetClientCallbackOnInterstitialsShown, the enterprise report of a shown SSL interstitial.
Account settings button forced off; MaybeBuildGoogleServicesSettingsButton emptied.
PLATFORM_USES_CHROMIUM_EV_METADATA removed on every platform; RemoveEVCA return value flipped. The only Astro-originated security-relevant deletion in the stack.
astro:// registered standard + secure + CORS-enabled + savable with no recorded trust model.
' Astro/<version>' appended to full and reduced User-Agent.
Settings text tells users data is sent to Oxy while the implementations still target Google endpoints or are disabled entirely.

unclassified.unknown: deliberate 'no Google help-centre links' policy, or collateral damage from hand-editing
unclassified.settles_it: whether the C++ callers still supply the $1/$2 substitution arguments for those six message ids, and whether grit accepts the mismatch; needs a build of the patched resource targets

unclassified.unknown: whether replacing a copyright notice with 'Made with ❤️ in the 🌎 by Oxy.' satisfies the epic's licence and attribution requirement
unclassified.settles_it: a licensing answer, not a measurement

unclassified.unknown: whether the policy is 'no help links at all' or 'Astro-hosted help links'
unclassified.settles_it: the same #10 decision as item 1; determines restore-upstream vs point-at-Oxy-docs

001-branding-strings.patch.retires_by: Regenerate product strings from the single branding source (#9).

hunk_classifications.detail: Replaces 'Copyright <ph name="YEAR">{0,date,y}</ph> The Chromium Authors. All rights reserved.' with 'Made with ❤️ in the 🌎 by Oxy.' — removes an attribution notice and a format placeholder the caller supplies. Licensing question, not branding.
Substituted fake domains written into otherwise-clean upstream strings.

001-branding-strings.patch.notes: 43 hunks, one file. Added and removed line counts equal; <message name=> id set identical both sides; every changed pair except those above is explained by the substitution map.

004-default-search-duckduckgo.patch.retires_by: Retires when the search-default decision is recorded in the feature matrix.
004-default-search-duckduckgo.patch.notes: The only patch the baseline disposition marks 'keep'. Implementation seam: GetPrepopulatedFallbackSearch in components/search_engines/template_url_prepopulate_data.cc.

005-branding-components-strings.patch.notes: Measured clean: 0 changed line pairs unexplained by the substitution map.

006-user-agent-astro.patch.retires_by: Retires when the UA decision is recorded (#10) with a fingerprinting review (#20).
006-user-agent-astro.patch.notes: Appends ' Astro/<version>' to both the full and reduced User-Agent — a permanent, network-visible identifier on every request.

008-os-crypt-visibility.patch.retires_by: Disappears if the token store uses OSCrypt async; otherwise one allowlist line naming //astro.
008-os-crypt-visibility.patch.evidence: components/os_crypt/sync/BUILD.gn:12 carries a visibility allowlist; components/os_crypt/async/*/BUILD.gn imposes none on the browser target. The overlay currently includes components/os_crypt/sync/os_crypt.h.

009-branding-settings-strings.patch.retires_by: Regenerate settings strings (#9), settings surface owned by #15.

hunk_classifications.hunk: 3 hunks removing <ph name="BEGIN_LINK" href="$1"> help links
hunk_classifications.detail: Memory saver, energy saver, preload pages. Message ids unchanged; C++ callers may still supply $1.
Includes a live href to https://safebrowsing.9oo91e.qjz9zk/safebrowsing/report_error/ — a clickable link to a domain that does not resolve.
Frame/tab-background colour set to Oxy fuchsia.
Inactive-tab foreground now returns white instead of falling through to COLOR_TOOLBAR_TEXT's kGoogleGrey800 — a second decision inside a patch named for one.

011-astro-url-scheme-alias.patch.retires_by: Deleted. Neither half has a successor.

hunk_classifications.detail: Parses an auth callback inside HandleChromeAboutAndChromeSyncRewrite, writes identity prefs, stores access and refresh tokens, and LOG(INFO)s the username.
The cosmetic chrome:// alias, explicitly rejected going forward.

012-settings-border-style.patch.retires_by: Settings surface re-styled through #15, not by patching Chromium resources.

hunk_classifications.detail: Card border/shadow styling.
if="[[learnMoreUrl]]" -> if="[[false]]": disables the settings subpage help button for every subpage. Behaviour, not styling.

013-settings-google-to-oxy.patch.retires_by: Re-author settings strings (#9 + #15); do not carry the substitution forward.

hunk_classifications.hunk: Safe Browsing / spell check / live caption / UKM disclosure strings
hunk_classifications.detail: Google->Oxy substitution over user-facing privacy disclosures whose implementations are unchanged: 'Text you type in the browser is sent to Oxy', 'Oxy Safe Browsing', 'Real-time, AI-powered protection ... sent to Oxy'.
keep-sites-active, inactive-tab indicator, performance alerts.
Highest count in the stack.

014-oxy-profile-menu-header.patch.notes: Declares what 015 implements; 015 cannot apply or retire without it.

015-oxy-profile-menu-impl.patch.retires_by: Deleted with CL-6; the menu seam is re-created by #24, not preserved.

hunk_classifications.detail: Builds .../login?client_id=astro-browser&redirect_uri=astro://auth/callback&response_type=token — an implicit-flow sign-in that returns tokens in a URL.
should_show_settings_button hard-coded false. Byte-identical to ungoogled remove-unused-preferences-fields.patch.
Empties MaybeBuildGoogleServicesSettingsButton(). Byte-identical to the same ungoogled patch.

016-ntp-astro-logo.patch.retires_by: Removed: Chromium's NTP resources stop being Astro's NTP surface.

017-ntp-logo-css.patch.notes: Also switches -webkit-mask-image to background-image, disabling the single-colour theming path.

019-ntp-default-sites.patch.retires_by: Retires when the shipped tile list is a stated product decision.
019-ntp-default-sites.patch.notes: Rewrites all three default_popular_sites*.json to DuckDuckGo / Wikipedia / GitHub / Reddit. Product endorsements, not de-Googling.

hunk_classifications.detail: Registers oxy.access_token and oxy.refresh_token as plaintext profile string prefs. Must not be carried into the hook.

Removes safe_browsing::RegisterLocalStatePrefs, safe_browsing::RegisterProfilePrefs, ntp::SafeBrowsingHandler::RegisterProfilePrefs, screen_ai::RegisterLocalStatePrefs and three includes. MEASURED: all 9 removed lines are byte-identical to deletions ungoogled patches already make (remove-unused-preferences-fields, fix-building-without-safebrowsing, disable-ai). Astro originates none of them — but dropping the ungoogled patch does not restore the behaviour, because this patch removes the same lines independently.

020-register-oxy-prefs.patch.evidence: Deletion attribution: every '-' line matched against every '-' line under patches/ungoogled/.

021-omnibox-display-astro.patch.notes: LocationBarModelImpl::GetFormattedURL rewrites chrome:// to astro:// for display.

022-autocomplete-astro-scheme.patch.retires_by: Retires with the real astro:// scheme; no per-site rewrite remains.

omnibox-autocomplete-filtering command-line switch — content of ungoogled extra/ungoogled-chromium/add-flag-for-omnibox-autocomplete-filtering.patch.
Substituted-domain comment (view-source:9oo91e.qjz9zk).

hunk_classifications.detail: Pushes "astro" onto standard_schemes, secure_schemes, cors_enabled_schemes and savable_schemes at once, with no trust model recorded anywhere.

hunk_classifications.detail: 'Sends URLs of pages you visit to Oxy', 'Automatically sends usage statistics and crash reports to Oxy', 'Encrypt synced passwords with your Oxy Account'. 041-navigation-controller-astro.patch.retires_by: Retires with the real astro:// scheme.

hunk_classifications.detail: Two substituted-domain comment-only hunks (ch40m1um.qjz9zk). Pure noise; revert to upstream.

hunk_classifications.detail: Removes #define PLATFORM_USES_CHROMIUM_EV_METADATA so every platform takes the stub path.
EVRootCAMetadata::RemoveEVCA changes from return true to return false; four LOG(WARNING) lines dropped.

044-disable-ev-certificate-metadata.patc.notes: THE ONLY Astro-originated security-relevant deletion in the stack. Exists to correct the Iridium patch, whose dummy OID "0" fails ASN.1 decoding at startup; if #8 drops that patch, 044 has nothing to correct.

046-adblock-prefs.patch.notes: Hunk context is 020's last added line (oxy.token_expiry), so 046 cannot apply or retire before 020.

047-alia-side-panel-entry-id.patch.retires_by: One entry in the SidePanelEntryId X-macro list.
047-alia-side-panel-entry-id.patch.notes: Genuinely needs a Chromium edit: the enum is generated from a macro list in a Chromium header.

048-alia-action-id.patch.retires_by: One entry in the chrome_action_id X-macro list.
048-alia-action-id.patch.notes: Same shape as 047; the two together are the minimum Chromium delta for a side-panel entry.

051-alia-vector-icon.patch.retires_by: Disappears: //astro declares its own aggregate_vector_icons target and owns alia_spark.icon.
051-alia-vector-icon.patch.evidence: aggregate_vector_icons is a public template from //components/vector_icons/vector_icons.gni used by 12 BUILD.gn files in the locked tree. The patch exists only because src/chrome/app/vector_icons/alia_spark.icon was placed in a Chromium-owned directory, which tools/overlay.allowlist has to declare as an exception.

053-adblock-toolbar-button.patch.retires_by: Replaced by an Astro toolbar hook.
053-adblock-toolbar-button.patch.notes: BROKEN AS COMMITTED: assigns to adblock_button_, a member no patch declares, upstream does not have, and tools/overlay.allowlist does not permit the overlay to supply. Treat as a statement of intent, not as working code to preserve.
053-adblock-toolbar-button.patch.evidence: No patch touches toolbar_view.h; grep -n adblock on the locked tree's toolbar_view.h returns nothing.

054-adblock-webui-register.patch.retires_by: Disappears: //astro registers its own WebUI configs from its ChromeBrowserMainExtraParts. No Chromium-owned edit, and no astro::RegisterWebUIConfigs hook.
054-adblock-webui-register.patch.notes: Declared collision: tools/overlay.allowlist records that the untracked whole-file copy of chrome_web_ui_configs.cc reverts it. The copy, not this patch, is the shipped registration path — and the copy omits the adblock config entirely. Both go together.
054-adblock-webui-register.patch.evidence: content/public/browser/webui_config_map.h declares WebUIConfigMap::GetInstance(), AddWebUIConfig and AddUntrustedWebUIConfig public on a CONTENT_EXPORT class whose comment tells embedders to use them; RegisterChromeWebUIConfigs() has exactly two callers in the locked tree (chrome/browser/chrome_browser_main.cc:1830 and chrome/test/base/chrome_unit_test_suite.cc:205). Registering from PostProfileInit or PreBrowserStart runs after line 1830. Established for #7 in minimum-chromium-hooks.md section C1 and re-verified here.

055-ntp-webui-register.patch.notes: Its hunk context contains 054's added line, so 055 strictly depends on 054.

056-ntp-redirect-to-astro.patch.retires_by: Replaced by an Astro NTP URL hook.
056-ntp-redirect-to-astro.patch.notes: Two hunks: the local NTP URL, and IsInstantNTPURL recognition of the Astro host.
